Tradever Clipper Brief
Motion Management | TikTok, Instagram Reels & YouTube Shorts | September 2026
Read before posting. Content that violates campaign rules may not qualify for payout.
1. Page Requirements
* Dedicated trading/Tradever page; page name must include Tradever.
* Do not impersonate Tradever or claim to be official.
* Use approved Tradever content only.
2. Content Formats
Slideshows are the priority. Post both formats, but focus most of your output on slideshows.
Slideshows: 5–7 slides, dark backgrounds, bold white text, one idea per slide. Use TikTok Photo Mode or Instagram Carousel.
Slideshows structure:
1. Hook — bold claim, stat, or question.
2. Point one — explain the benefit.
3. Point two — build credibility.
4. Optional — another benefit or payout proof.
5. CTA — prominent Tradever logo + call to action.
Slideshows examples: https://www.tiktok.com/@tradever.clips150/photo/7697447404588633374?is_from_webapp=1&sender_device=pc


Rotate these hook angles:
* Payout stories: Funding and payout experiences.
* Myth busters: Common trading and prop firm mistakes.
* Rule breakdowns: Weekly payouts, no consistency rule, EOD drawdown.
* CEO quotes: Direct quotes with supporting context.
Use trending audio. Add a small Tradever logo to slides 1–4 and a prominent logo on the final slide.
Video clips: Use approved CEO clips, podcast moments, trading insights, reactions, lifestyle moments, and payout discussions. Keep edits fast, natural, and engaging.
3. Logo & Tagging
* Use the official Tradever logo.
* Keep the logo visible throughout every video.
* Tag @tradeverfunding and @laythbanks on every post.
* End every caption with both tags.
4. Posting Requirements
* Vertical 9:16 format; English only.
* Minimum 7 seconds per video and 3 slides per slideshow.
* Post at least 5 times per week.
* Keep posts live for at least 30 days.
* Keep likes visible.
* Minimum 2% engagement rate.
* Audience must primarily be Tier 1. Over 30% Tier 3 audience may result in removal.
* No NSFW content.
5. Editing & Prohibited Content
* Strong hook in the first 1–3 seconds of videos.
* Remove dead space; use clean edits and high-quality exports.
* Captions recommended for videos.
* No platform watermarks, skull edits, or phonk sounds.
* No competing prop firms or unrelated content.
* No bots, fake engagement, purchased views, paid boosting, or ads.
* Do not repost the same content across multiple accounts or submit the same clip twice.
6. Example Content
Study the hooks, pacing, branding, and captions. Do not copy directly.

7. Payment
* Rate: $1 per 1,000 views.
* Budget: $2,000 total (2 million paid views).
* Campaign closes when the budget is exhausted. Early, consistent posting gives you more opportunity to earn.
The goal: Build a real trading page that distributes quality Tradever content organically—not a page full of advertisements.
